_: Стиль «Преступления Отпавшего Листа» (docs/stories/leaf-story.md): внешний мир — кубофутуристическая и лучистская живопись 1912–1918 (Гончарова, Ларионов, Розанова, Попова; фигуры — как гуашевые эскизы костюмов Экстер), пёстрая и тревожная; внутренний мир Ранума — супрематическая геометрия на белом, её рисует движок; лист — единственный натуральный предмет (у пропа своя technique и фон-маджента).
cutout: Painted as a figure in a Russian avant-garde painting of 1912–1918 — cubo-futurism and rayonism, in the manner of Natalia Goncharova's and Olga Rozanova's paintings and Alexandra Exter's gouache costume designs for Tairov's Kamerny Theatre: the body and clothes built of bold angular faceted planes with crisp edges, strong dark brushed contours, slanting rays of colour crossing the forms; the face simplified and mask-like yet clearly readable and dignified, not a caricature; bright saturated tempera and gouache colours (vermilion, ultramarine, chrome yellow, emerald, ochre, black and white) with visible brushstrokes and a matte paper texture. Natural painted edges: no outline around the whole figure, no white border, no paper margin, not a sticker. The whole subject fully visible, nothing cropped.
cutout_bg: Isolated on a perfectly flat, uniform pure chroma-green (#00FF00) background — nothing else in the image: no room, no wall, no floor, no ground, no shadow.

Natural painted edges — no outline around it, no border.

Natural painted edges — no outline around it, no border, not a sticker.

backdrop: A wide painted backdrop in the manner of Russian cubo-futurist and rayonist painting of 1912–1918 (Natalia Goncharova, Mikhail Larionov, Olga Rozanova, Lyubov Popova): the scene broken into angular, faceted, interpenetrating planes, slanting beams and rays of light crossing the image, a dynamic tilted perspective — yet the place stays clearly recognisable; bold saturated colours (vermilion, ultramarine, chrome yellow, emerald, ochre, black and white), visible brushwork, matte canvas texture. No people.
